candidates.name: bullish_breakout_from_right_edge_consolidation
candidates.context_definition: Price had been recovering or advancing and then paused in a small right-edge consolidation near a nearby resistance level.
conditions_sequence: A prior upward leg or rebound is already in place.
Price forms a small consolidation, pause, or pullback near the right edge.
Price approaches the top of that local range or prior swing high.
candidates.presence_rule: Present when the right edge is still inside the small consolidation/pullback but has not yet completed a candle close beyond the local resistance.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closes above the most recent local swing high or consolidation high.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle closes back below the recent pullback low or back inside the prior range after the breakout attempt.

candidates.name: bullish_rebound_breakout_after_drop
candidates.context_definition: Price had sold off into a lower area, then formed a base and started rebounding from the recent low.
conditions_sequence: A sharp decline creates a recent swing low.
A small base, bounce, or recovery forms above that low.
Price climbs back toward nearby short-term resistance or the zero line.
candidates.presence_rule: Present when the rebound is visible and price is pressing into the rebound high or local resistance, but has not yet closed above it.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closes above the rebound high or local resistance formed after the drop.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle makes a new lower low below the recent rebound base or selloff trough.

candidates.name: bearish_breakdown_from_right_edge_range
candidates.context_definition: Price had been ranging or consolidating and then started rolling over from a local high or upper part of the range.
conditions_sequence: A sideways or choppy range forms at the right edge.
Price turns down from the upper part of that range or from a local rebound high.
Bearish candles push into the lower part of the range or through nearby support.
candidates.presence_rule: Present when price is pressing against the lower edge of the local range but the decisive close below support has not yet occurred.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closes below the local support, pullback low, or range floor.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle closes back above the recent local highs or reclaim area of the range.

candidates.name: bearish_continuation_below_broken_support
candidates.context_definition: Price had already broken down from a prior range or spike and was continuing to trade lower beneath broken support.
conditions_sequence: A prior support area or range floor is broken.
Price remains below that broken level and makes lower highs or lower lows.
The right edge shows renewed selling or another push through the latest minor low.
candidates.presence_rule: Present when the breakdown is already underway and price is still below the broken support, but the latest continuation close has not yet occurred.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closes below the most recent swing low, pullback low, or support shelf.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle closes back above the broken support area or above the most recent lower high/rebound high.

candidates.name: bullish_continuation_after_spike_and_pullback
candidates.context_definition: Price had already made a strong impulsive rally, then paused or retraced slightly near the highs.
conditions_sequence: A sharp upward impulse creates a spike high or breakout area.
A shallow pullback or tight consolidation forms just below that high.
Price holds above the prior breakout zone and retests the highs.
candidates.presence_rule: Present when the pullback is still above the breakout area and the right edge is compressing near the high, but no fresh breakout close above the high has printed yet.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closes above the recent spike high or immediate pullback high.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle closes back below the breakout base, pullback low, or prior consolidation top.

candidates.name: bearish_rejection_from_recent_high
candidates.context_definition: Price had pushed up into a recent high or upper range and then failed to continue higher.
conditions_sequence: Price reaches a recent high or upper range boundary.
A rejection or pullback begins from that elevated area.
Bearish candles retrace part of the prior rise toward nearby support or the zero line.
candidates.presence_rule: Present when the rejection is visible and the move has turned down from the top, but the decisive close below the next support has not yet occurred.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closes below the nearest short-term support, pullback low, or consolidation floor after the rejection.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle closes back above the recent high or reclaim area of the rejected top.

candidates.name: bullish_breakout_from_right_edge_range
candidates.context_definition: Price had sold off or drifted lower, then formed a rebound and/or consolidation near flat or the 0.00% area, with recent candles pushing back toward nearby highs.
conditions_sequence: Price is recovering or ranging near the right edge after a decline or pullback.
A local rebound high or consolidation ceiling is visible near the top of the current range.
Price approaches that resistance with small pullback or hesitation candles.
A completed candle closes above the visible nearby resistance on the right edge.
candidates.presence_rule: Counts as PRESENT once the right edge is testing the local high area and the close has not yet completed above it.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closing above the recent right-edge swing high or consolidation ceiling.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle closes back below the recent pullback low or back into the prior consolidation/range after the test.
information_required: recent swing high or consolidation ceiling

candidates.name: bearish_breakdown_from_right_edge_support
candidates.context_definition: Price had rebound attempts or range trading after a prior decline, then started rolling over from a local high or lower-high structure near the right edge.
conditions_sequence: Price is making a right-edge rebound, lower-high sequence, or choppy consolidation after a prior rise or bounce.
A nearby support floor or recent swing low is visible in that right-edge structure.
Recent candles show pressure lower into that support.
A completed candle closes below the visible support or recent swing low.
candidates.presence_rule: Counts as PRESENT once price is pressing into the local support area and the close has not yet completed below it.
candidates.trigger: A completed candle closing below the recent right-edge support or swing low.
candidates.invalidation: A completed candle closes back above the recent rebound high or recovers back into the broken range.
information_required: recent swing low or support floor
recent rebound high or lower-high area
